note: Named, leased exemptions for the real-tree worktree/branch audit (issue #1291), scoped to the repository instance they were measured in (issue #1321). Each entry excuses ONE artifact — kind, name, and the tip the exemption was measured at — and only while the lease below holds AND this document is in force in the venue the check is running in: `venue.git_common_dir` names the repository instance (every worktree of one checkout, lane worktrees included, answers it; no other clone does). At that venue every rule bites: a new artifact is never absorbed (it is not listed), an artifact whose tip has moved is not absorbed (it is no longer the artifact named here), and an entry that no longer targets an unmatched artifact FAILS as a stale exemption until it is removed in a reviewed edit. At ANOTHER venue the whole document is inert — reported entry by entry as NOT-APPLICABLE, honouring nothing (an artifact that is unmatched there stays a finding: this document does not speak for that checkout) and not fatal (a stale exemption is a claim about THIS disk, which another checkout cannot observe). That distinction is the fix for #1317, which emptied this document because its entries could never be honoured on a pristine clone — a true measurement whose remedy un-quarantined all of them on the one box that has them. Every entry is the AGENTS.md rule 17 class: work that exists nowhere else, which the worker is forbidden to discard, so it must be reported rather than silently red — and reported rather than silently reaped.

venue.why: The repository instance these exemptions were measured in — every worktree of this checkout (lane worktrees included) resolves to it, and no pristine clone does. Without it, `the artifact is gone` and `the artifact was never here` are indistinguishable, which is what made #1317 empty this document.
